peer_separation.boundary: Phase-vocoder-baseline is a deterministic classical comparison on the elastic PCM fixture. It has no neural transient-preservation model and is not this candidate.
Rubber Band R3 is a classical phase-vocoder control with percussive transient phase resets, not neural transient preservation. No Rubber Band result is inherited.
Neural WSOLA is a distinct neural waveform TSM family with its own blocker. No source, checkpoint, geometry, rejection count or metric is inherited or pooled here.
The FFmpeg atempo screen is an adjacent conventional timing control. The pinned research explicitly states it is not this candidate; no atempo measurement is inherited.
